subject: Hosted API evaluation - quickstart, endpoints & rate limits
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API demo — next steps and quickstart

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the demo today. Great to hear about the fraud-detection use case and the low-latency requirements for real-time scoring. Per our conversation, I wanted to summarize the immediate next steps and highlight a few Hosted API details to help you evaluate quickly: 

Quickstart:
- Sandbox keys: you can spin up an API key and hit our hosted endpoints within minutes.
- We’ll send a pre-configured Postman collection and a step-by-step quickstart PDF (attached).

Endpoints & rate limits:
- Single-region hosted endpoint: api.redwood.com/v1/generate (we’ll provide account-specific host if you want regional routing).
- Default rate limits for trial accounts: 60 requests/minute with 8 concurrent streaming connections.
- If you need predictable higher throughput, Dedicated capacity is the recommended path (reserved GPU pools).

Data & security:
- Hosted API supports encrypted-at-rest and optional customer-managed keys for higher tiers. If you have strict VPC/on-prem requirements, that maps to our Private offering.

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll send the quickstart materials and sandbox key by EOD.
2) Try the endpoint with a 1-hour smoke test and share any output quality concerns.
3) If throughput or isolation looks necessary, we can scope Dedicated capacity options and provide a cost estimate.

Can you confirm whether you want to focus the initial eval on Hosted sandbox (fast) or do you want us to include Dedicated sizing in the first call?

Thanks —
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

Attachment: redwood-quickstart-guide.pdf

From: Sam Patel <sam@fintechco.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: FinTechCo Solutions <solutions@fintechco.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 10:43:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Hosted API demo — next steps and quickstart

Thanks Aditya —

Appreciate the recap. A few quick clarifying questions before we kick off the smoke test: 

1) Rate limits and concurrency — our estimator shows peak of ~120 reqs/min with up to 20 concurrent streams during peak windows. Can the hosted tier be configured temporarily for that level, or would we immediately need Dedicated?
2) Regional routing — latency to our primary customers in US-EAST needs to be <70ms p50. Does the default hosted endpoint guarantee region selection?
3) Data retention — are logs/audit trails available for 90 days, and can we disable storage of raw inputs on hosted?

Also looped in our solutions contact; we’ll try the quickstart this week. If hosted requires pre-approval or a ramp plan for the rate limits above, we should evaluate Dedicated capacity in parallel.

Best,
Sam
Head of Platforms, FinTechCo
sam@fintechco.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API demo — next steps and quickstart

Aditya — forwarding Sam's questions so we can align. My notes below; please add if I missed anything.

- Rate limits: Hosted trial has conservative defaults (60 rpm / 8 concurrent). For POC increases we can request a temporary soft-limit bump to ~150 rpm for 1-2 weeks while they validate. Anything beyond that we should scope for Dedicated.
- Regional routing: For hosted, we can route by region based on account setting; p50 will depend on model size and prompt length. We'll include the p50 numbers from our hosted benchmarks for the model they tried.
- Data retention: Hosted provides 90-day audit logs on Business and above. Raw input storage can be disabled for compliance (we have an opt-out toggle for PII-heavy accounts) — needs SLO note for debugging tradeoffs.

Next actions I can take:
- Provide benchmark p50/p95 for their model and region (I'll pull from Console).
- Open a temporary soft-limit request for the trial to support 150 rpm.
- Draft a short mutual-action plan: quickstart -> smoke test -> decision point (hosted vs dedicated).

If you want, I can be on the call with Sam next week to cover benchmarks and retention.

—Marissa
Director, Solutions Engineering
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Mar 2026 09:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API demo — next steps and quickstart

Hi Sam —

Thanks — great questions. Quick answers and concrete next steps below: 

1) Rate limits & concurrency:
- We can enable a temporary requested bump to 150 reqs/min and 20 concurrent streams for the POC (1-2 week window) — Marissa will open the request today.
- For sustained production at that scale we recommend Dedicated; I can get you a sizing + cost estimate once we see CPU/GPU utilization from the smoke test.

2) Regional routing & latency:
- We can pin the hosted endpoint to us-east-1 to reduce network hop. I’ll include our measured p50/p95 for the exact model and prompt size in the next email (Marissa is pulling console metrics).

3) Data retention & logs:
- 90-day audit logs are available on Business and above. We can disable raw input retention for the account; note that disabling retention limits postmortem debugging. We’ll put that in the mutual-action plan as an explicit acceptance item.

Next steps (summary):
- Today: Marissa will share benchmark p50/p95 and open the soft-limit bump.
- This week: Sam to run the smoke test using the attached quickstart. We’ll standby to monitor and adjust limits as needed.
- Next week: Quick sync to review logs and decide Hosted vs Dedicated path.

I’ll attach the Postman collection and API examples. Let me know if you want a quick 30-min follow-up next week to review results.

Thanks,
Aditya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

Attachments: api-rate-limits-2026.csv; postman-collection.json
